SEARCH
Package data

Interface DataStore

All Known Implementing Classes:
JdbcDataStore, MockDataStore
public interface DataStore
Everything the screens need from the database. JdbcDataStore talks to squad_21_db. MockDataStore keeps sample data in memory and is used when there is no db.properties.

      Throws:

    • saveOrder

      int saveOrder(int employeeId, List<OrderLine> lines, double subtotal, double tax, double tip, String paymentMethod)
      Saves a completed sale and its lines, and lowers on-hand stock for the inventory the drinks use.

      lines - the items ordered

    • refundOrder

      boolean refundOrder(int orderId)
      Marks an order refunded. Stock is not put back, because the drinks were already made.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the order number
      Returns:
      true if the order was refunded; false if it doesn't exist or was already refunded

    • getSalesSummary

      SalesSummary getSalesSummary(LocalDate from, LocalDate to, String category)
      Totals for the Sales Dashboard. Refunded orders are left out.
      Parameters:
      from - the first day, inclusive
      to - the last day, inclusive
      category - only count this menu category, or null for all categories
      Returns:
      totals, units per item and sales per day for the window

    • getItemSales

      List<ItemSales> getItemSales(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      Sales for every menu item, including retired items and items with no sales, for the Sales Report. Excludes refunds and uses historical line prices.
      Parameters:
      from - the first day, inclusive
      to - the last day, inclusive
      Returns:
      one row per menu item, sorted by revenue, highest first
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for missing dates or an invalid range

    • getInventoryUsage

      List<InventoryUsage> getInventoryUsage(LocalDate from, LocalDate to)
      How much of each inventory item sales used, for the Inventory Usage report. Refunded sales count too: the drink was already made, so its ingredients and supplies are gone either way. Usage for an inventory row is quantity sold times servings_used; rows for the same item (same name, category and unit) are added together.
      Parameters:
      from - the first day, inclusive
      to - the last day, inclusive
      Returns:
      one row per inventory item, most used first

    • getHourlySales

      List<HourlySales> getHourlySales(LocalDate day)
      X-report for one day. Read only.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a row for each hour that had a sale or refund, earliest first

    • addInventoryItem

      InventoryItem addInventoryItem(String name, String category, String unit, int menuId, int onHand, int fillLevel, int suggestedFill)
      Adds an ingredient, topping or supply for one menu item.
      Parameters:
      name - the item's name
      category - ingredient, topping or supply
      unit - the unit of measure; may be blank
      menuId - the drink this row is stocked for
      onHand - units in stock
